methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective single-center ESCC cohort (n=104 development, 30 temporal validation) with ResNet152 deep learning model for NCIT response prediction. Two-stage feature selection (mRMR then LASSO) applied. Model training/validation split with 5-fold cross-validation. FDR correction applied for multiple comparisons. External validation on TCGA (n=94) and GSE160269 for mechanism exploration. Limitations: single-center, modest sample, short follow-up (1-year RFS only), lack of PD-L1 comparison, no prospective validation.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Discovery/exploratory study developing predictive biomarker for ESCC neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy response using AI pathomics. Addresses unmet clinical need for treatment response prediction in locally advanced ESCC. Clinical utility speculative; mechanisms correlative rather than causally proven. No functional validation of identified targets (EIF2S3-UPR axis).

reporting_quality.justification: Comprehensive AI/pathomics study with detailed methodology: WSI preprocessing protocols, ResNet152 architecture modifications, feature extraction strategies (inverse distance weighting for spatial correlation), machine learning classifier comparisons (7 algorithms), SHAP analysis for interpretability, nomogram construction, decision curve analysis. External validation methodology transparent. Data availability: no statement regarding raw WSI or model code availability.

novelty_literature.justification: First AI pathomic model specifically for NCIT response prediction in ESCC. Combines histopathological image features with clinical variables (T stage, P53 status). Integration of mechanistic validation using TCGA/GEO transcriptomics and single-cell data novel. However, prior ESCC-PS system reported by Li et al. achieved AUC 0.904 for PFS prediction with immunotherapy; this work extends to neoadjuvant setting with clinical variable integration.

writing_presentation.justification: Well-organized AI-driven pathomics paper with clear clinical motivation, transparent methodology describing deep learning pipeline, comprehensive result presentation with multiple validation cohorts, mechanistic insights linking image features to molecular pathways (ER stress-UPR). Discussion addresses clinical translatability and discusses radio-pathomic future directions. Publication-ready clarity.

key_strengths: Integrated model combining pathomic ECiT score with clinical variables (T stage, P53) achieves superior predictive performance (validation AUC 0.809) compared to single-modality approaches, demonstrating additive value of multimodal data fusion

Rigorous deep learning methodology with two-stage feature selection, multiple classifier comparison favoring logistic regression for generalizability, SHAP analysis providing feature importance interpretation addressing 'black box' concern

Mechanistic validation using TCGA/GEO transcriptomics and single-cell data identifies EIF2S3-mediated ER stress-UPR axis as potential driver of NCIT resistance, linking pathomic features to tumor microenvironment immune function
External validation in TCGA cohort and GSE160269 demonstrates model transferability, though limited to mechanistic exploration rather than prospective outcome prediction
key_concerns: Single-center retrospective study with relatively small sample (n=104 development, n=30 temporal validation); temporal validation cohort quite limited; selection bias risk with R0 resection-only inclusion
Short follow-up period (1-year recurrence-free survival only) insufficient for long-term prognostic validation; lacks long-term overall survival and disease-free survival endpoint assessment

No comparison with standard immunotherapy biomarker PD-L1; missing qualitative assessment of muscle mass and body composition; no quantification of residual staining variability impact on model despite Vahadane algorithm application

Mechanistic findings (EIF2S3-UPR correlation with pathomic features) correlative rather than functionally validated; lacks in vitro/in vivo studies confirming EIF2S3 role in regulating ER stress, lipid droplet metabolism, and immune function
chief_reviewer.rationale: Solid AI/pathomics discovery study with rigorous deep learning methodology and mechanism exploration, but single-center design, limited sample, short follow-up, and lack of prospective/external outcome validation limit tier placement to 3. Appropriate for specialty journals with clear framing as preliminary findings requiring multicenter prospective validation.
